annotations.title: Look up one business on Canopy

description: Match one business the user named to its Canopy listing, by phone, website, or name (add the city, state or ZIP code when you know it). Returns at most one match, with its booking_mode and locations, or found=false. When a name alone is not certain, found=false comes with up to 5 candidates in alphabetical order for the user to choose from.

address.description: City, state and ZIP code of the business.

business_name.description: Business name as you found it. With no phone or website, add the address city, state or ZIP when known.

name: resolve_business
